What to record: Identify the project, room, assembly, finish schedule, and active revision.
Record applicator, inspector, or handoff owner plus the relevant date.
Identify substrate, product, color, sheen, lot, and current instructions.
Record approved sample, specification, manufacturer sheet, drawing, or signed standard.
Record rooms reviewed, doors, drawers, hardware, appliances, and demonstrations.
Example: Kitchen and pantry / all functions shown

What to record: Record manuals, warranties, finish care, touch-up, attic stock, keys, and digital files.
List punch, exclusions, owner-supplied work, dates, contacts, and access.
Record photos, recipient, signatures, date, and any written reservations.
Example: Report HR-08 / signed with P-021 open
